pay_detail: Unpaid. Students can earn service hours.
name: Volunteer Squad (summer teen volunteers)
what_you_do: Volunteer at the library over the summer. High school students can earn service hours. The library also keeps a list of volunteer options in the community.
who_can_apply: The page says the Volunteer Squad is open to students entering grades 8 to 12 in fall 2026. No age or residency rule is listed.
deadline_text: The page says opportunities are posted in the spring and take place over the summer. No dates are given for 2027.
how_to_apply: The page does not say how to apply. Check the volunteer page in spring or ask the library.
notes: The contact email on the page was a blank placeholder. Call or visit the library.
